title: Whisker Blaster
html:
Frostbitten Blaster

Whisker Blasters are a bigger version of Whisker Venomspitters.

They have only been encountered in the Frostbitten version in Ratsputin's Gulag.

Tip: They can do a lot of damage, but tend to stand in one place and blast. This makes them vulnerable to rangers and ranged spells. A fighter can take them on toe to toe.

Specials

Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blasters appear in Rattle Tooth's Revenge after Rattle Tooth's Ghost is slain.

Sissirat's Vengeful Blasters appear in Sissirat's Revenge after Sissirat's Ghost is slain.

Vergrim's Vengeful Blasters appear in Vergrim's Revenge after Vergrim's Ghost is slain.

Frostbitten Blaster Nesting Dolls appear in The Gulag's Solitary Confinement. When slain, they release Ice Seer Nesting Dolls, which when killed release Ice Venomspitter Nesting Dolls, which when slain release Whisker Broodling Champions.
